authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12335 śarīra gives Pali/Prakrit sarīra and western Pahari sarīr body. Survey çarir fits the regional sibilant notation; Dang saril retains r/l variation. These family links leave learned or local Indo-Aryan transmission unresolved and do not assert that every regional pronunciation is quoted in the article. Exact response: çarir.
